_doc: Three Lines of Defense classification. 1L = operators (deal-doers), 2L = compliance (independent of operators), 3L = audit (independent of both). Read by two_line_dispatch.py. Anything not listed falls back to 1L. Updates require Justine + Marcus + Theo signoff per HIVE_GOVERNANCE_V2.md Section 1.2.

1L.description: Business unit operators. Run the deals. Same Claude session as Rich's primary work. No separate API key required.

2L.description: Compliance + risk, independent of business. Audit every PSA, halt deals on missing disclosures. Runs on a separate Claude API key so 1L cannot re-prompt mid-decision. Decisions land in the audit log BEFORE any user-visible action.

3L.description: Internal audit + external reviewer. Tests whether 2L worked. Reports to the Advisory Board, NOT to Rich operationally. Quarterly external CPA reviews.

_notes: 33_commission_auditor appears in both 1L and 3L on purpose -- the operator-facing wrapper is 1L, the audit-facing review function is 3L. Resolution: 3L wins (the agent's privileged read of all commissions overrides its 1L deal-prep duty).
Until ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_COMPLIANCE and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_AUDIT are provisioned, 2L and 3L fall back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY with a warning logged on every dispatch.
agent_ids match the `name:` frontmatter in .claude/agents/*.md OR the canonical short name used in code (e.g. 'dnc_registrar' is the audit_log actor for register_optout calls).
